The '''Mu tree''' was a species of [[Tree/Legends|tree]] native to the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Isamu]] in the [[Birjis system/Legends|Birjis system]]. The trees grew in pairs, and at night their shadows looked like lovers kissing. Seven [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Saahir Ru'luv]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Thaddeus Ross]] fulfilled a promise to visit a grove of Mu trees on Isamu they discovered so he could finally forgive her for breaking his heart.<ref name="LAD" />
